free_tier.stated: withdrawn. The platform told users it would stop operating on 2025-05-20 after NVIDIA acquired the company, and the site has not served content since: a Wayback capture from 2026-02-27 recorded status 503, and two live routes returned nothing.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: none: the successor is NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton, which is sold through partner clouds and needs a partner account.
limits_note: nothing binds: there is no account to open and no endpoint to call, and the successor is NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton, sold through partner clouds.
binding_note: nothing binds: there is no account to open and no endpoint to call, and the successor is NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton, sold through partner clouds.

evidence.proved: the Wayback capture of the same URL recorded status 503 with a 643-byte body, measured from the archive
'Lepton 将于 2025 年 5 月 20 日正式停止运营' -- Lepton would stop operating on 2025-05-20; the site had already blocked new registrations; NVIDIA had completed the acquisition, reported by 36Kr and cnBeta

notes: The rung is reported, not documented, because the vendor page no longer serves a sentence to quote and the archive holds a 503 rather than content. The shutdown notice is a user message reproduced by two Chinese outlets, alongside NVIDIA acquisition coverage. Recorded dead because the service stopped on a stated date and the host does not serve; stale aggregators still list Lepton with per-token pricing.
